text:
That august brow crowns all sea surrounds and sun shelters; what he does not govern, God punishes by not subjecting it to him.


Clothing Flora and Pomona, he commanded time to follow his colors and winter deny its ice.


He sent west the envious sun that turned December to May, its light frowning and gold faint.


He ran gallantly and struck bravely; cane became arrow and lightning; Lope alone could sing him.

translation.title: That August Brow Which Crowns
